tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Catalogue of Tuper spreadsheet templates: for each its name, who it is for, tabs, price in USD, free or paid, page URL and (paid) Polar buy link. Includes the Stocktake Kit and the bundle price. Filter by access.

tools.name: find_template
tools.description: Find templates by trade, job or need, e.g. "landlord", "bakery", "stocktake", "mileage", "wedding", "invoice". Matches names, who each is for and tab names; free versions first when one exists.

tools.name: get_free_template
tools.description: Returns https download URLs (.xlsx, plus a filled example when it exists) of one free template, e.g. "free-rental-property-spreadsheet" or a trade name ("landlord", "invoice"). Only files already free on tuper.app/templates/free/ are returned; paid files never are.
